formula: historical Core index + discipline coefficient * historical Discipline index + historical Faceoff adjustment + historical Physicality bonus
aggregation: Historical Core and Discipline indices must cover identical eligible seasons and the same position.
comparisonGroup: Same latest recorded NHL position; eligible matched histories.
percentileMethod: Midpoint percentile for ties using unrounded Performance indices.
ratingMethod: Percentile divided by 10, rounded to one decimal.
missingDataPolicy: Missing, mismatched and ineligible histories remain ungraded. Core results are preserved separately.
disciplinePolicy: The Discipline index already includes the drawing bonus. It is not added a second time. PIM includes fighting and misconducts; this is not a power-play opportunity estimate.
faceoffPolicy: Apply signed adjustments in qualifying Faceoff seasons included in Core history. Divide their sum by all qualifying Core seasons. Documented nonqualifying seasons receive no adjustment; missing records fail.
physicalityPolicy: Average saved capped season bonuses equally across qualifying Core seasons, including valid zero bonuses. No second coefficient is applied. Missing eligible records fail. Positive-only index credit does not guarantee a nondecreasing percentile grade.
interpretation: Provisional descriptive performance composite, not contract value, total season value delivered or projected ability.
note: Review outputs only. Existing Core files and website grades are unchanged by this runner.
